_comment: Titan-slayer theme (CLAUDE.md §4.3 decision, 2026-07-27). Cards are DATA (§11). 'starter_deck' = each hunter's opening deck; 'reward_pool' = cards offered between encounters (build step 4 meta-progression). Combo cards target an ally or the Titan to reward coordination (§6): cover/rally help your ally, expose/harpoon set up focus-fire, draw_aggro tanks a telegraphed hit for your ally.

expose.name: Expose
expose.text: Expose: its next 2 hits taken deal +4.

draw_aggro.name: Draw Aggro
draw_aggro.text: Taunt the Titan this round. Gain 6 Block.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.text: Deal 8 damage, then Expose the Titan (1).

grip.name: Grip
grip.text: Climb the Titan (+2 Height). Reach a high weak point.

sunlight_blade.name: Sunlight Blade
sunlight_blade.text: Deal 5 damage, +3 for each Exposed stack on the Titan.

bowshot.name: Bowshot
bowshot.text: Deal 3 damage and Expose the Titan (1).

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.text: Gain 2 Strength — your attacks deal +2 for the rest of this fight.

rend.name: Rend
rend.text: Deal 4 damage and Poison 2 (it bleeds each turn).

tongue_lash.name: Tongue Lash
tongue_lash.text: Deal 3 damage and pull yourself up (+1 Height).

build_grapple.name: Build Grapple
build_grapple.text: Build a Grappling Hook and add it to your hand.

grapple.name: Grappling Hook
grapple.text: Time it! Climb +1 (+2 nailed) or it slips away.

vine.name: Vine
vine.text: Climb (+1); grow a vine that lifts your ally (+2 Height).

spore.name: Spore Burst
spore.text: Deal 2 damage and Poison 2 (the beast bleeds each turn).

rope_up.name: Rope Up
rope_up.text: You and your ally both climb (+1 Height).

belay_strike.name: Belay Strike
belay_strike.text: Deal 3 damage, +2 for each Height you've climbed.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.text: Time it! 4 dmg (+5 nailed) and hop up +1.

flick.name: Tongue Flick
flick.text: Time it! Flick for 2 (+3 nailed) or it slips away.

lash_out.name: Lash Out
lash_out.text: Time it! 3 (+4 nailed), Poison 2, lift ally +1.

creeper.name: Creeper Vine
creeper.text: Time it! Climb +1 (+2 nailed); ally climbs +1.

piton_drive.name: Piton Drive
piton_drive.text: Time it! 2 dmg, +2 per your Height (+4 nailed).

haul.name: Haul Up
haul.text: Time it! Both climb +1 (you +2 more nailed). Miss and it slips away.

piston_punch.name: Piston Punch
piston_punch.text: Time it! A massive timed blow: 8 (+8 nailed). Miss and it slips away.

goblin_jetpack.name: Goblin Jetpack
goblin_jetpack.text: Prime it — next turn you rocket to the weak point.

grappling_arm.name: Grappling Arm
grappling_arm.text: Pull your ally up to your Height (within 3 below).

build_mech.name: Build Mech
build_mech.text: 2 Block, +2 for each Build Mech played this fight.

burn_coal.name: Burn Coal
burn_coal.text: Sacrifice a card to cut another card's cost by 1 this fight.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.text: Sacrifice a card to launch your ally +2 Height.

meld.name: Meld
meld.text: Fuse two cards into one that does both, costing 1 less.

satchel_charge.name: Satchel Charge
satchel_charge.text: Nail 3 timings in a row: detonate for 26. Any miss fizzles.

tongue_snap.name: Tongue Snap
tongue_snap.text: Time it! 2 dmg (+3 nailed), +3 per Rhythm, hop +1.

hop.name: Hop
hop.text: Time it! Hop +1 (+1 nailed), +1 per Rhythm.

leapfrog.name: Leapfrog
leapfrog.text: Spring off the beast: you climb +2 and vault your ally +2.

toxic_lash.name: Toxic Lash
toxic_lash.text: Time it! 2 dmg (+3 nailed), +2 per Poison. Poison 1.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.text: You climb +1; vines haul your ally +3 Height.

blightbloom.name: Blightbloom
blightbloom.text: 1 damage and Poison 3 (it bleeds each turn).

summit_strike.name: Summit Strike
summit_strike.text: Time it! 2 (+3 nailed), +2 per Height of EACH hunter.

belay.name: Belay
belay.text: Anchor your ally: give them 6 Block and climb them +1 Height.

pitons_in.name: Pitons In
pitons_in.text: Hammer pitons: you and your ally both climb +2 Height.

anchor_line.name: Anchor Line
anchor_line.text: Both gain 4 Block; your ally climbs +1.

crest_strike.name: Crest Strike
crest_strike.text: Time it! 4 (+4 nailed), +3 per Height climbed.

build_bomb.name: Build Bomb
build_bomb.text: Build a Bomb into your hand.

bomb.name: Bomb
bomb.text: Time it twice! 4 (+12 nailed). Miss and it fizzles.

dig_in.name: Dig In
dig_in.text: Time it! Brace for 4 (+6 nailed). Mistime it and you take the blow bare.

anchor_brace.name: Anchor Brace
anchor_brace.text: Time it! You gain 2 Block; your ally 4 (+6 nailed).

deploy_bulwark.name: Deploy Bulwark
deploy_bulwark.text: Bolt a shield plate together and add it to your hand.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.text: Time it! Slam it down for 3 Block (+8 nailed) or it buckles.

grand_leap.name: Grand Leap
grand_leap.text: Time it! Vault the beast: +3 Height (+3 nailed), +2 per Rhythm. 4 damage (+4).

summit_push.name: Summit Push
summit_push.text: You and your ally climb +2. Deal 5 damage, +3 per your ally's Height.

overload_engine.name: Overload Engine
overload_engine.text: Time it twice! 10 damage (+16 nailed). Any miss and the engine floods.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.text: Plant yourself: both hunters gain 10 Block. Taunt the beast this round.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.text: Settle into the beat: +3 Rhythm and 3 Block.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.text: Spring off your ally: both climb +1. +1 Rhythm.

double_tap.name: Double Tap
double_tap.text: Time it! Strike twice for 3 (+2 nailed), each +1 per Rhythm.

sticky_tongue.name: Sticky Tongue
sticky_tongue.text: Time it! 2 damage (+3 nailed) and Expose 2.

pass_the_beat.name: Pass the Beat
pass_the_beat.text: Draw 1, +2 Rhythm, and your ally gains 1 Energy.

springboard.name: Springboard
springboard.text: Launch your ally +3 Height and catch the beat (+1 Rhythm).

long_jump.name: Long Jump
long_jump.text: Time it! Climb +2 (+2 nailed), +2 more per Rhythm.

snap_volley.name: Snap Volley
snap_volley.text: Three snaps of 2 damage, each +2 per Rhythm.

crescendo.name: Crescendo
crescendo.text: 3 damage, +5 per Rhythm. Climb +1, +1 more per Rhythm.

seedling.name: Seedling
seedling.text: Poison 1; the shoot pulls you up +1 Height.

root_network.name: Root Network
root_network.text: Poison 2; roots haul your ally +2 Height.

sap.name: Sap
sap.text: Time it! Two hits of 2 (+2 nailed), each +1 per Poison.

bramble_wall.name: Bramble Wall
bramble_wall.text: 3 Block, +3 for each Bramble Wall played this fight.

summit_call.name: Summit Call
summit_call.text: Your ally gains 1 Energy and climbs +1 Height.

counterweight.name: Counterweight
counterweight.text: Time it! Both climb +2; you climb +2 more if you nail it.

matched_pace.name: Matched Pace
matched_pace.text: Two hits of 3, each +1 per Height of EACH hunter.

chock_stone.name: Chock Stone
chock_stone.text: Time it! Both gain 4 Block; your ally 5 more if you nail it.

belay_master.name: Belay Master
belay_master.text: You gain 3 Block; your ally gains 6 Block and climbs +2.

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.text: Burn a card from your hand to draw 2.

build_winch.name: Build Winch
build_winch.text: Bolt together a Winch and add it to your hand.

winch.name: Winch
winch.text: Time it! Crank yourself up +2 (+3 nailed) or the cable slips.

build_turret.name: Build Turret
build_turret.text: Assemble a Turret and add it to your hand.

scrap_drive.name: Scrap Drive
scrap_drive.text: 3 damage, +3 for each card you have burned this fight.

pressure_valve.name: Pressure Valve
pressure_valve.text: 4 Block, +3 for each card you have burned this fight.

rocket_boots.name: Rocket Boots
rocket_boots.text: Time it! Blast up +4 Height (+4 nailed) or the fuel dumps.

chain_lift.name: Chain Lift
chain_lift.text: Grapple your ally up to your Height (within 5) and shield them 5.

detonator.name: Detonator
detonator.text: Burn a card: 4 damage, +6 for each card burned BEFORE this one.

tongue_grab.name: Tongue Grab
tongue_grab.text: Snag your ally up to your Height (within 4). +1 Rhythm.

perfect_pitch.name: Perfect Pitch
perfect_pitch.text: Time it! 2 damage (+3 nailed), +4 per Exposed stack.

hopscotch.name: Hopscotch
hopscotch.text: Climb +1, +2 more per Rhythm. Your ally climbs +1.

whiplash.name: Whiplash
whiplash.text: Time it! 4 damage (+4 nailed), +3 per Rhythm.

tempo_trap.name: Tempo Trap
tempo_trap.text: Time it! Expose 2, +1 Rhythm, climb +2 if you nail it.

finale.name: Finale
finale.text: Two hits of 6, each +4 per Rhythm.

barbed_vine.name: Barbed Vine
barbed_vine.text: Time it! Ally climbs +2 and gains 5 Block if you nail it. Poison 1.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.text: Your ally gains 5 Block and climbs +1. Poison 1.

rappel.name: Rappel
rappel.text: Time it! 3 damage (+3 nailed), +2 per your Height.

guide_rope.name: Guide Rope
guide_rope.text: Pull your ally up to you (within 4) and shield them 4.

brace_together.name: Brace Together
brace_together.text: Time it! Both gain 3 Block, +4 each if you nail it.

crux_move.name: Crux Move
crux_move.text: Time it! 3 damage (+4 nailed), +3 per Height of EACH hunter.

the_two_of_us.name: The Two of Us
the_two_of_us.text: Both climb +3. 6 damage, +3 per your ally's Height.

oil_can.name: Oil Can
oil_can.text: +2 Strength for the rest of this fight.

scrap_heap.name: Scrap Heap
scrap_heap.text: Burn a card from your hand to gain 6 Block.

build_drone.name: Build Drone
build_drone.text: Assemble a Shield Drone and add it to your hand.

drone.name: Shield Drone
drone.text: Send it to your ally: 6 Block and +1 Height.

scrap_shield.name: Scrap Shield
scrap_shield.text: Both gain 3 Block; you gain 2 more per card burned this fight.

wrecking_ball.name: Wrecking Ball
wrecking_ball.text: Time it! A huge swing: 8 damage (+10 nailed). Miss and it sails past.

grand_contraption.name: Grand Contraption
grand_contraption.text: 6 damage, +4 per card burned this fight. Builds a Bomb into your hand.
